A '''field box''' was a type of case used by [[Agent/Legends|agents]] and [[Spy/Legends|spys]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] to store important information that they had learned. [[Bellis]], a Republic spy on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]], owned a field box in which he stored information about a [[ZR-57 orbital strike bomb]] captured by a group of [[Mantellian Separatist Movement|separatists]] shortly before his [[Death/Legends|death]] at their hands during the [[Separatist War]].
